inputs.text:
Open your eyes. The establishment is pushing out these carefully scripted fairy tales about a French abbot named Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame (FMND), being convicted in PARIS, France under some newly cooked-up legislation targeting what they call “psychological subjection.” They want you to believe this is just a standard legal proceeding sending ripples of concern through religious communities and civil liberties advocates. 

Don't fall for the official script. This is pure narrative inversion and a coordinated clampdown by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the French legal apparatus. They invent these vague, Orwellian charges precisely to silence true spiritual authority and dismantle independent communities that refuse to bow to state control. The panic they claim is happening among civil liberties advocates is just theater to mask a systematic, premeditated agenda to purge independent thought.
